Thus my weight h(x)h(y)[f(x)/h(x)-f(y)/h(y)]^2 is exactly your weight f_nu(x)f_nu(y)[h_mu(x)/f_nu(x)-h_mu(y)/f_nu(y)]^2. Both equal [D_mu(x)D_nu(y)-D_mu(y)D_nu(x)]^2/[D_nu(x)D_nu(y)].
